topic: A person learns their favorite restaurant is closing
text: The path through the trees is familiar, the earth layered with soft moss and the quiet hum of insects. The air carries a hint of ripe berries, a gentle promise of nourishment. I move slowly, my paws barely disturbing the leafy carpet, senses alert yet untroubled. A familiar scent drifts on the breeze, comforting and steady, like the center of a well-known clearing. There are places, things, that become a part of the rhythm of life, as constant as the sun on my fur or the shadows of the night. When one such place fades, it is like the branch of an old tree snapping quietly in the wind—noticeable in its absence, yet the forest carries on, lush and full of life. I know where the wild berries grow, and the stream runs clear just beyond. The world is vast and filled with paths yet unexplored.
